CreateTextFile.description_en: Uploads a document to the contract review module. After the document is added, the system automatically starts parsing the file and returns the corresponding file ID for subsequent generation of review rules and review results. File parsing uses a queuing mechanism. If the queue is long, the file may take some time to be parsed
CreateTextFile.description_zh: 该接口用于将文档上传到合同审查模块中，添加成功之后，系统会自动启动文件的解析，并返回对应的文件ID用于后续生成审查规则和审查结果。文件解析有排队机制，如果队列较长，文件可能需要等待一段时间才能解析完成

RunContractExtract.description_en: This API extracts specified fields from contract content. You provide a contract URL and a list of fields to extract, and the service returns the extracted field values
RunContractExtract.description_zh: 该接口用于根据合同内容抽取相应的字段。用户输入合同链接和抽取字段信息后会进行对应字段抽取

RunContractResultGeneration.description_en: Generates contract review results for the contract review module by calling a large language model to return review results, risk items, and suggested modifications. Incrementally returns the model-generated review results through Server-Sent Events (SSE) based on the specified contract review file ID, review stance, and review rules
RunContractResultGeneration.description_zh: 该接口用于合同审查模块的审查结果生成，调用大模型返回合同的审查结果、审查风险项、建议修改内容等。传入合同审查文件的ID、审查立场、审查规则，会通过sse的方式增量式返回模型生成的审查结果

RunContractRuleGeneration.description_en: This operation uses a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate intelligent contract review rules. It returns the generated rules and associated threats for a specified contract. You provide the contract file ID and the review stance. The model returns results incrementally using Server-Sent Events (SSE)
RunContractRuleGeneration.description_zh: 该接口用于合同审查模块的智能规则生成，调用大模型返回合同的审查规则和对应风险。传入合同审查文件的ID、审查立场，会通过sse的方式增量式返回模型生成的审查规则

RunSearchCaseFullText.description_en: Retrieves relevant cases for a user-described question. After a user inputs a question, this operation calls a large language model to parse the question, generates search criteria, and retrieves matching cases based on the criteria
RunSearchCaseFullText.description_zh: 该接口用于检索用户描述的问题对应的相关案例。用户输入问题后，会调用大模型解析用户问题生成对应的检索条件，并根据检索条件检索对应的案例

RunSearchLawQuery.description_en: This API is used to retrieve relevant regulations corresponding to a user-described question. After the user inputs a question, a large language model is called to analyze and retrieve the corresponding laws and regulations
RunSearchLawQuery.description_zh: 该接口用于检索用户描述的问题对应的相关法规。用户输入问题后，会调用大模型分析并检索对应的法规法条
